name: United Business Card

otherLounges: United Club: 2 one-time passes per year
loungeAccess.notes: Not full United Club membership — only 2 complimentary one-time United Club passes per year. Full United Club membership requires the United Club Infinite Card.

tripCancellation.notes: Trip cancellation/interruption insurance up to $1,500 per person, $6,000 per trip. Must purchase common carrier tickets with the card.

lostBaggage.notes: Lost luggage reimbursement up to $3,000 per passenger.

baggageDelay.notes: Baggage delay insurance up to $100/day for 5 days if baggage is delayed more than 6 hours.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Not a standard benefit on the United Business Card.

emergencyMedical.notes: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services available (referral service only).

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Primary auto rental collision damage waiver for business rentals. Decline the rental company's CDW.

otherCredits.name: First Checked Bag Free
otherCredits.notes: Free first checked bag for you and one companion on United-operated flights. Saves up to $35/bag each way — up to $70/round trip savings per person.

otherCredits.name: United Club Passes
otherCredits.notes: 2 complimentary United Club one-time passes per year.

otherCredits.name: Premier Upgrades on Award Tickets
otherCredits.notes: Eligible for complimentary Premier upgrades on award tickets.

otherCredits.name: 25% Inflight Rebate
otherCredits.notes: 25% back as a statement credit on United inflight purchases (food, beverages, Wi-Fi).

otherCredits.name: Employee Cards
otherCredits.notes: Add employee cards at no additional cost.

rewards.baseRate: 1x United MileagePlus miles per $1 on all other purchases
rewards.travelRate: 2x on United purchases; 2x on dining; 2x on gas stations; 2x on office supply stores
rewards.diningRate: 2x United MileagePlus miles on dining (restaurant purchases)
otherBonusCategories: 2x on United purchases (tickets, in-flight, United Club memberships, etc.)

pointValue.transferPartners: United MileagePlus miles — use on United and Star Alliance partners. Miles valued at ~1.0-1.5 cents each on domestic flights, potentially more on international premium cabins.

travelPerks: Free first checked bag (you + 1 companion) on United flights
2x miles on United, dining, gas, office supply stores, and local transit
2 United Club one-time passes per year
Primary rental car insurance for business rentals
Premier Qualifying Points (PQP) toward United status
Earn United PQP faster — 500 PQP per $12,000 spent each calendar year (up to 1,000 PQP)
bestFor: Frequent United flyers who want to earn MileagePlus miles, save on checked bags, and build toward United status
